guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul / Gibson ES-175 / Telecaster
guitar.evidence: Slash's Gibson Les Paul (famously a Kris Derrig replica used on Appetite for Destruction) is iconic; Izzy Stradlin's rhythm work on Telecaster/other guitars is also documented.

tone.target: clean arpeggio with chorus sheen and wide delay
tone.profile: clean arpeggio with chorus sheen and wide delay
tone.summary: A polished 90s clean arpeggio tone achieved with a US Deluxe amp model, Chorus for sheen, and Digital Delay/Plate Reverb for space.
corrections: keep modulation subtle, not washed out

rig.name: Guns N' Roses - Don't Cry - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Add sustain and smooth out the attack for arpeggios.
blocks.gap: The Comp is ideal for clean, sustained tones.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and articulate; bypass distortion.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender-type sound required for 90s arpeggios.
Provide a bright, articulate cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp.
Add the required 'chorus sheen' and width to the arpeggios.
Brighten the high end and add articulation to the clean tone.
blocks.gap: A slight boost in treble is needed for 'bright articulate attack'.

blocks.purpose: Create the 'wide delay' effect and add depth to the arpeggios.
Add light, polished ambience and space (reverb).
blocks.gap: Plate reverb is excellent for clean, spacious tones.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism for a more authentic, polished 90s Fender-style clean tone.

proposals.reason: Improve the vintage character and polish of the US Deluxe sound.
